info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Clinozoi Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Clinozoi Recliner Detail Management API facilitates the creation and management of detailed catalog entries for Clinozoi recliners. It allows manufacturers or retailers to upload specifications, images, and features of recliner products in a structured format. This API is typically used by inventory management systems and e-commerce platforms to ensure accurate product listings and enhance customer engagement. By integrating this API, businesses can streamline their product catalog processes and improve the overall user experience in showcasing their offerings.

post.description: This operation allows you to create detailed information for a Clinozoi recliner. It captures all necessary specifications and features to provide comprehensive insight into the product.

requestBody.description: The request body for creating or updating the details of a Clinozoi recliner. It must adhere to the defined schema and include all necessary attributes required for the operation.
